items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I enjoyed working with that band... Especially after Johnny Borg (PHONETIC) got in it.

ctx.x: Do you prefer to play in small bands to big bands?

Not necessarily. It's hard to say I don't miss the big bands, because I'd be telling tales. I miss all that brass and saxophone, oh, no. But in a good band, like Joe Kelly's band, I enjoyed working with that band, because we'd sound like a big band. (Sound effect) Especially after Johnny Borg (PHONETIC) got in it. Oh, man, I'm telling you. So I, you know, I enjoyed working with Joe. But then I'm not saying I don't miss the big bands.
What was the last big band that you were with?
